what: Andrew (via coordinator): locations as data, design docs/v2/plan/design/item-hash.md section 12. A per-crate location table, entries named by (item identity, slot): code loads its &Location / line!() / file!() from it by relocation; patch identity (patch.rs Mark::new locations, patch_hash DataRequest::Location) leaves values out, so a move or line edit is a live patch that writes only data. Release bakes values. Differential test: program output (line!, column!, file!, track_caller, panic text) equal to a fresh build and the nightly after moves, and the live patch has no code section. Builds on 00957.
